paragraphs.source_en: “In mine, in space, in city and sky, we have lived our lives in fear. Fear of death. Fear of pain. Today, fear only that we fail. We cannot. We stand upon the edge of darkness holding the lone torch left to man. That torch will not go out. Not while I draw breath. Not while your hearts beat in your chests. Not while our ships yet have menace in them. Let others dream. Let others sing. We chosen few are the fire of our people.” I beat my chest. “We are not Red, not Blue or Gold or Gray or Obsidian. We are humanity. We are the tide. And today we reclaim the lives that have been stolen from us. We build the future we were promised.

units.source_en: “In mine, in space, in city and sky, we have lived our lives in fear.
Today, fear only that we fail.
We stand upon the edge of darkness holding the lone torch left to man.
That torch will not go out.
Not while your hearts beat in your chests.
Not while our ships yet have menace in them.
We chosen few are the fire of our people.”
“We are not Red, not Blue or Gold or Gray or Obsidian.
And today we reclaim the lives that have been stolen from us.
We build the future we were promised.

paragraphs.source_en: “Guard your hearts. Guard your friends. Follow me through this evil night, and I promise you morning waits on the other side. Until then, break the chains!” I pull my razor from my arm and let it take the shape of my slingBlade. “All ships, prepare for battle.”
